snippet.title: Astral Dive Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4772280/Astral_Dive/
